primaryContext.candidateText: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”
primaryContext.fixedText: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

context.text: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.
Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

primaryContext.candidateText: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,
primaryContext.fixedText: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

context.text: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,
and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

primaryContext.candidateText: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”
primaryContext.fixedText: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

context.text: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.
We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

primaryContext.candidateText: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,
primaryContext.fixedText: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

context.text: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,
to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: 記事本文は現代ネゲブ地域と、聖書のネゲブが北寄りの範囲を指す場合、また「南」を意味する用法を区別します。境界を同一視しないため関連記事として示します。

geography.identityCheck: 27:10「ユダのネゲブ」は地域名。30:27の「ネゲブのラモテ」は同じ語を含むが地名の範囲が異なる。人名や町名と混同しない。
geography.uncertainty: ヘブライ語表現は地域名と方位「南」を含み、章ごとに範囲が変わる。従来の候補点は境界を表さない。

changedFields.summaryJa: 1サムエル記27:10では、アキシュの問いに対し、ダビデが南方への襲撃先を答えます。

addedFacts.textJa: アマレク人が「南方」とツィクラグを襲撃したと記される。
襲撃者はケレテ人とカレブに属する南方地域を襲ったと述べる。
分捕り物の送り先として「南方のラモト」が挙げられる。
